chunks: And from him, from his father Ahmad ibn Dawud, from Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Dawud al-Sarmi, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him saying: 'Whoever visits my father, for him is Paradise.'

key_terms.أَبِي: my father (referring to Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the Imams according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this chain from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) conveys a tradition from his father, Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), declaring that visiting him guarantees Paradise. This narration underscores the unique spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia theology, where physical or spiritual visitation (ziyarah) serves as a means of drawing closer to divine grace and securing eternal reward.
